title: Online Sports Betting Taxes by State, 2026
summary: The market for sports betting will likely continue to grow substantially as more states allow legal operations or expand existing operations to online services. State governments are often enticed by potential tax revenues. As the tax base grows, tax policy design becomes increasingly important.

title: Spain’s 2026 Election: Diverging Tax Agendas and the Push for Full Expensing
summary: Spain’s 2026 election presents a clear divide in economic policy, with the Socialist Workers' Party favoring higher taxes on capital and businesses, while the People’s Party and Vox advocate tax cuts to encourage investment, stimulate economic growth, and improve competitiveness.

summary: Unfortunately, not all bipartisan efforts will make for sound tax reform. Both parties have leaned into the “no tax on” trend in recent years, complicating the tax code and narrowing the US income tax base.

title: Digital Services Taxes in the United Kingdom and Belgium Create Large Economic Harms per Unit of Revenue
summary: Evaluations of digital services taxes in the UK and Belgium show tiny annual revenue collections relative to the total treasury revenue raised by the government. Our dynamic modeling shows digital services taxes reduce both labor and capital supply, lowering investment, GDP, and labor compensation.

title: The State Tax Competitiveness Index Is Your Guide to Economic “Wins Above Replacement”
summary: Taxes are an important part of the mix, and modernizing a state’s tax structure helps position it for growth. States that rank better on the Index have better-structured tax codes, and states with better-structured tax codes get Wins Above Replacement.

title: 2027 State Tax Competitiveness Index
summary: The State Tax Competitiveness Index enables policymakers, taxpayers, and business leaders to gauge how their states’ tax systems compare. While there are many ways to show how much state governments collect in taxes, the Index evaluates how well states structure their tax systems and provides a road map for improvement.
